Package org.dreambot.api.methods.construction

Class Rooms

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Rooms
  • public class Rooms
extends java.lang.Object
    Selects and places rooms from the room build menu (widget 212). XPE class.

    • Method Summary

      All Methods Static Methods Concrete Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method Description
      boolean isOpen()
      Checks whether the room build menu is open. XPE method.
      java.lang.String roomName​(java.lang.String text)
      Extracts the room name before the colon in a menu row, such as Kitchen from Kitchen: Lvl 5. XPE method.
      int[] plotOrigin​(int x, int y)
      Gets the origin coordinates of the plot faced by the door tile. Returns null for a room corner or interior tile. XPE method.
      boolean leadsToEmptyPlot​(org.dreambot.api.methods.map.Tile door)
      Checks that the plot faced by this door has no door hotspot of its own. The menu decides whether construction is allowed when a corner hotspot cannot be judged. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject doorway()
      Gets the nearest door hotspot on the current floor facing an empty plot. XPE method.
      java.util.List<java.lang.String> names()
      Gets the names shown in the open room menu. XPE method.
      java.lang.String describe()
      Describes the room names in the open menu on one line. XPE method.
      boolean choose​(java.lang.String name)
      Scrolls the named room into view and clicks its menu row. XPE method.
      boolean choose​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Room room)
      Selects the room by its menu label, falling back to the room's own name. The Skill hall is listed as Hall - Skill trophies. XPE method.
      Place place​(int coinsBefore)
      Builds the ghost room, rotating it up to four quarter turns if needed. Pass the coin count from before the ghost appeared. Returns BUILT if the coins were spent, CHOSEN if Build was selected without spending coins, or NOT_BUILT otherwise. XPE method.
      boolean build​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Room room)
      Builds the room from the nearest empty doorway. DUNGEON is not built through a doorway; use Dungeon - Stairs below a staircase. XPE method.
      boolean build​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Room room, org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject door)
      Builds the room through the specified doorway by selecting its room entry and placing the ghost. XPE method.
